claims.explanation: MG-132 is a proteasome inhibitor whose selectivity likely reflects dependence on proteasome-mediated degradation of pro-apoptotic or stress-response proteins, with sensitive lines showing proteasome-addiction signatures such as high proliferation/ubiquitin-pathway gene expression and intact apoptotic signaling. The virtual-cell response (up BAG3, CDKN1A, PMAIP1; down TOP2A, CDK1) and similarity to ixazomib support proteasome inhibition as the mechanism, while resistant lines often carry mutations (e.g., SF3B1, ALK, PTEN-only) that may reduce dependence on proteasome-regulated survival pathways.

features.basis: MG-132 annotated target; higher proteasome subunit expression may increase dependence on proteasome activity
virtual cell upregulation; BAG3 is a stress/anti-apoptotic chaperone whose proteasomal degradation is blocked by MG-132
virtual cell upregulation; p21 induction reflects proteasome inhibition and may mark cells reliant on proteasome for cell-cycle progression
virtual cell upregulation; NOXA is a pro-apoptotic BH3 protein stabilized by proteasome inhibition
TP53 mutations are common in both sensitive and resistant lines, but wild-type TP53 may be required for optimal apoptotic response to proteasome inhibition
SF3B1 mutations appear enriched in resistant lines (TE4, HCC95, CAL12T, UO31 sensitive but many resistant), suggesting altered splicing reduces proteasome dependence
ALK-mutant neuroblastoma and mesothelioma lines are among least affected, possibly due to ALK-driven survival bypassing proteasome-regulated apoptosis
PTEN-mutant lines (ZR751, WM793 sensitive but many resistant) may have PI3K/AKT-driven survival less dependent on proteasome
NFE2L2 mutations appear in several sensitive lines (TE6, KYSE70, SNUC5), possibly via NRF2-driven proteasome addiction
BRAF mutations appear in several sensitive lines (8305C, WM793, SNUC5) but also resistant lines, so weak evidence
KRAS mutations appear in resistant lines (CL11, OV7, PATU8988S) and some sensitive lines, suggesting context-dependent effect
virtual cell downregulation; high baseline TOP2A/proliferation may predict sensitivity to proteasome inhibition
